text:
kevin: Quick check — handoff for console observability features (dashboards, tracing hooks, error analysis views, retention). Are we green for the phase-gate next Wed? Need owners + any blocked deps. cc @anna @jordan

anna: tagging owners — tracing hooks -> jordan, dashboard views -> dina, retention policy + runbook -> carol. Product PM is @mike. Mike, can you confirm QA acceptance criteria?

mike: Confirmed. QA needs: 1) error heatmap on the main insights page, 2) trace linkouts from spike items, 3) retention policy doc + rollback runbook. Target sign-off: Tue EOD.

jordan: tracing hooks implemented server-side; waiting on runtime lib rollout to propagate hook payload + sampling header. @dina any ETA on the lib canary->stable?

dina: lib canary deployed to 10% now. If no regressions I'll promote to stable tomorrow morning. Blocking item: infra needs to bump KV config (size/quota) for prefix caching.

carol: retention PR is up (docs linked in #docs). Quick question from ops: default 90d vs 60d. Ops prefers 60 to reduce storage during GA; product may want 90. @mike?

mike: let's go 60d default for GA and add 90d as opt-in. We'll document cost tradeoffs in the release notes.

kevin: owners/next steps recap: jordan = tracing runtime + verify hook payload, dina = lib rollout, carol = retention PR + runbook, mike = QA acceptance. Blockers: infra KV bump, UX copy for error view. @infra can you take the KV bump?

ops-bot: Deploy canary started by @dina — build #4523 — https://ci.redwood/builds/4523 :rocket:

infra: I can provision KV quota tomorrow AM. Assign to @kevin to validate the config once it's up.

kevin: thanks — can each owner drop a one-line status update by EOD so I can assemble the phase-gate checklist? 

anna: sounds good. Also reminder: schedule a 30m oncall window for the sampling bump during canary. @carol pls coordinate.

carol: will schedule and post a short runbook. I'll also watch errors and post any regressions in this thread.

dina: the config I applied to canary for tracing sampling:
```yaml
tracing:
  sample_rate: 0.1
  export: enabled
```
I'll post any canary logs if we see anomalies.

jordan: quick note — need to validate that trace IDs are linkable from the UI list. If UX team can't render linkouts we'll fallback to a downloadable trace blob. @dina FYI for payload size.

kevin: perfect. If no surprises tomorrow morning we'll move to phase-gate prep. Thanks everyone — drop those one-liners and I'll aggregate into the checklist. :thumbsup:
